# Computational requirements

## Software

* **R 4.4.2** (2024‑10‑31) or later
* All R packages pinned in `renv.lock` – restore with:

```r
install.packages("renv")
renv::restore()
```

* External tools: `git`, `zip`/`unzip`, C/C++ build tools.

## Hardware & runtime

Pipeline tested on a MacBook Pro (M1,36GB RAM); `targets::tar_make()` completes in **<3h**, peak RAM <16GB.

# 3 Quick‑start

```r
# clone repository -----------------------------------------------------------
# git clone https://github.com/<user>/red_trade.git
# cd red_trade

install.packages("renv")   # once
renv::restore()             # recreate package environment

library(targets)
tar_make()                  # run full pipeline
```

Outputs (tables, figures) will be written to `output/`.

## 3.1 Pre‑computed heterogeneity data (outside the pipeline)

The cross-country DiD heterogeneity analysis (Phase 2d) uses two moderating
variables — USA streak as #1 trade partner and V-Dem press freedom — that
require reading the full trade data from 1986 and installing the `vdemdata`
package (~200 MB). To avoid invalidating the entire pipeline (which takes
several hours), these variables are pre-computed by a **standalone script**
and saved to `data/heterogeneity_vars.rds`. The pipeline then imports this
file as a tracked dependency.

**To reproduce from scratch:**

```r
# Step 1: Run the standalone script (takes ~2 min; installs vdemdata if needed)
source("scripts/compute_heterogeneity_data.R")
# This reads from the {targets} store (classified_events, event_study_data_usa),
# computes usa_streak and press_free for all countries, and saves to:
#   data/heterogeneity_vars.rds

# Step 2: Run the pipeline (only new Phase 2d targets will build; ~10 sec)
library(targets)
tar_make()
```

**What the standalone script does:**

1. Reads `raw data/ITPDE_R03.csv` starting from 1986 (the pipeline uses 1990+)
2. For each treated country where China displaced the USA: counts consecutive
   years the USA was the #1 export destination, looking backwards from the year
   before treatment (`usa_streak`)
3. For never-treated countries: counts the USA streak backwards from the last
   year of data (2022)
4. Downloads V-Dem data (`v2x_freexp_altinf`) via the `vdemdata` package;
   computes a pre-treatment 5-year mean for treated countries and a 1995–2005
   mean for never-treated countries (`press_free`)
5. Saves the country-level data frame to `data/heterogeneity_vars.rds`

**Why outside the pipeline?** Changing the trade data filter from `year > 1989`
to `year >= 1986` inside `get_trade_data()` would invalidate `trade_data` and
all downstream targets, triggering a full rebuild (~6 hours). The standalone
approach avoids this entirely.

# Variable definitoions (codebook)

| Variable | Description | Source |
|----------|-------------|--------|
| `iso3c` | Three‑letter country code (ISO‑3166‑1) | Dynamic Gravity Dataset, USITC |
| `year` | Calendar year | UNGA ideal‑point dataset |
| `pop` | Population (millions) | Dynamic Gravity Dataset, USITC |
| `abs_distance_china` | Absolute distance to China in UNGA ideal‑point space | UNGA ideal‑point dataset |
| `gdp_cur` | GDP, current USD | Dynamic Gravity Dataset, USITC |
| `abs_distance_usa` | Absolute distance to the U.S. in UNGA ideal‑point space | UNGA ideal‑point dataset |
| `gpi` | Global Power Index | Diplometric — Pardee Institute |
| `us_power_gap` | U.S. GPI minus country GPI | Computed from GPI |
| `us_ideal` | U.S. ideal‑point estimate | UNGA ideal‑point dataset |
| `trade_with_china` | Goods trade with China (USD) | Dynamic Gravity Dataset, USITC |
| `trade_with_us` | Goods trade with United States (USD) | Dynamic Gravity Dataset, USITC |
| `total_trade` | Total goods trade (USD) | Dynamic Gravity Dataset, USITC |
| `distance_us` | Distance capital → Washington DC (km) | CEPII GeoDist via DG |
| `distance_china` | Distance capital → Beijing (km) | CEPII GeoDist via DG |
| `exchange_rate` | Market exchange rate (LCU per USD, annual avg.) | World Bank WDI (PA.NUS.FCRF) |
| `latin_america` | 1 = Latin America & Caribbean, 0 otherwise | Author coding (UN regions) |
| `pci_cur` | GDP per capita, current USD | Dynamic Gravity Dataset, USITC |
| `perc_trade_with_china` | Trade with China ÷ total trade | Author calculation |
| `perc_trade_with_us` | Trade with U.S. ÷ total trade | Author calculation |
